cues: Add phenol, and the orange colour vanishes at once, and a white precipitate forms: two four six tribromophenol.
All three activated positions are brominated in one go, with no catalyst.
In a non polar solvent like carbon disulphide at zero degrees, the reaction is gentler and gives mainly para bromophenol.
text: Watch bromine water. Add phenol, and the orange colour vanishes at once, and a white precipitate forms: two four six tribromophenol. All three activated positions are brominated in one go, with no catalyst. In a non polar solvent like carbon disulphide at zero degrees, the reaction is gentler and gives mainly para bromophenol.
